about_the_game:
A collection of weapon spray paints featuring a variety of styles, catering to diverse preferences while adding a distinctive personal mark to your firearms.

This expansion includes 6 weapon customization spray paints and item purchase authorizations from merchant(s).

Pack Includes:

  • Spray Paints:

    • Breaker (1 pcs.)

    • Ukiyo-e (1 pcs.)

    • Elegance (1 pcs.)

    • Graffiti (1 pcs.)

    • Digital Camo (1 pcs.)

    • Psychedelic (1 pcs.)

  • Merchant Store(s)

    • Unlocks 'Breaker' spray paint

    • Unlocks 'Ukiyo-e' spray paint

    • Unlocks 'Elegance' spray paint

    • Unlocks 'Graffiti' spray paint

    • Unlocks 'Digital Camo' spray paint

    • Unlocks 'Psychedelic' spray paint

Spray paints can be applied to weapons at the Spray Painting Booth in the Hideout.

Items included in this DLC will be sent via in-game mails. Please check your mailbox after purchase to claim your items.

DLC contents will be reissued after each data reset, its actual content is subject to change in future updates.
